name: Banpuri ~Ikinari Suwarete H Shiyo!~
original_name: ばんぷり ～いきなり吸われてＨしよ！～
source:
Main character lives alone as parents are gone on a business trip. He is approached by a vampire princess Yuri who boards in to live together. Her servant Lia and hero's childhood friend Kami won't leave the two in peace, so communal comedy life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母出差期间，主人公独自生活。吸血鬼公主优莉主动找上门，住进他的家中。她的仆人莉亚和主人公的青梅竹马香美不肯让二人安宁，热闹的共同生活喜剧由此开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-november-2007-demon.html]vndbreview[/url]]
